caption: The drawing depicts a single, cylindrical metal mug with a handle. The body of the mug is rendered in shades of brown with subtle variations that indicate a metallic, possibly copper material. The rim is rounded and slightly thicker than the body, and the base is solid and circular. The handle is attached to the side of the mug with two visible rivets and appears to be made of a different, darker metal, likely iron or steel, showing curved and angular shapes. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or designs, and the mug casts a faint shadow below. There is a small signature or inscription in the lower right corner in a reddish-brown color.
title: Mug
